title: Odd-Hermite Gram denominators are strictly positive on the regular channel chart

theorem.density: For 0<t<1, Y=sqrt(t)X+sqrt(1-t)Z has a strictly positive smooth density on R.
theorem.linear_independence: A nonzero polynomial cannot vanish almost everywhere under a strictly positive density.
theorem.conclusion: Every finite odd-Hermite Gram matrix is positive definite; its determinant and every principal minor are positive.

scope_guard: Strict positivity holds on the regular Gaussian-smoothed chart 0<t<1. Singular discrete faces remain separately typed.
